diff_summary: Refactored simulation, live WebSocket, and DBMS lock modules to domain APIRouters using FastAPI dependency injection (get_simulations, get_bus, admin, require_roles, get_race_db) with runtime state and main export fallbacks. Mounted domain routers directly in main.py, preserved factory functions and handler aliases, verified exact OpenAPI snapshot compatibility and unique route registrations.

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=backend:. APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_contract_snapshot.py backend/tests/test_route_registration.py backend/tests/test_simulation_replay.py backend/tests/test_api.py -k "test_runtime_route_registrations or test_current_openapi or test_websocket_bus or f_dom_05 or test_simulation_stop_clears_pending_pit_reservations" && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/mypy --strict backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app
